value.name: Rosa admits withholding soup intentionally
value.description: Rosa confirms she has been deliberately withholding soup from Asha before now.
evidence: "I have been doing it on purpose," Rosa said.

value.name: Rosa invites Asha to sit and eat
value.description: Rosa tells Asha the estate is closed, says she is no longer billing them, and offers her soup.
evidence: "Sit down, Asha. The estate is closed. You are no longer billing us. You can have soup."

value.name: Asha accepts the invitation
value.description: Asha sits down to join the others for the meal.

value.name: family shares lentil soup and bread
value.description: The group eats lentil soup and bread together at the dining table amid the estate paperwork.
evidence: The soup was lentil, with carrots and a great deal of pepper, and there was bread that Rosa had bought
They ate at the dining table, with the yellow pads pushed to one end and the pastry plate, now mostly empty, at the other.

value.name: Daniel offers market help to Lucia
value.description: Daniel offers to introduce Lucia to someone who knows the market in her neighborhood when she lists the New York apartment.
evidence: Daniel asked Lucia when she expected to list the New York apartment. Lucia said next month. Daniel said he could introduce her to someone, a friend of a friend, who knew the market in her neighborhood

value.name: Lucia accepts Daniel's help
value.description: Lucia agrees to Daniel's offer without turning it into a debt.

value.name: Asha recognizes work's real value
value.description: Asha privately realizes that the true result of her work is helping Daniel and Lucia learn to exchange small kindnesses.
evidence: Asha noticed that Daniel had offered her something useful without making it a transaction and that Lucia had accepted it without making it a debt, and she thought, eating her soup, that this was the actual deliverable of the work she had done in this house.
Not the codicil. Not the schedule of payment. The fact that two people who had not known how to give each other small things were, over lentil soup, beginning to learn.

value.name: Asha keeps her insight to herself
value.description: Asha chooses not to voice her realization and continues eating in silence.
evidence: She did not say this. She ate her soup.

value.name: Asha prepares to leave
value.description: At one-fifteen, Asha stands up to go.

value.name: Rosa escorts Asha to the door
value.description: Rosa rises with Asha and walks her to the doorway.
evidence: Rosa stood up with her and walked her to the door.
